# Code map

<!-- GENERATED by tools/build-codemap.js. Do not edit: change the source it names. -->

What lives where. One line per folder, code part, plugin and workspace library. Find the row,
then open it. (README) marks a folder with its own README. **Layer** is the layer, in
`tools/structure.js`, of the code part whose path covers the row: a part imports only parts on its
own layer or below. A blank means no part covers the folder. **Files** counts tracked files.

Where the purposes come from: `PARTS` in `tools/structure.js` (code parts), each plugin's
manifest, each workspace library's `package.json`, and `FOLDERS` in `tools/build-codemap.js`
(everything else). `build:check` fails when a folder directly inside one of the sections below has
no line. It does not check that a line is still true, and folders deeper down are covered by
their parent's line. To find a file or a symbol, grep: this map stops at folders.

Other maps: docs by topic, the routing table in `CLAUDE.md`; scripts and tools,
`dist/engineering/capabilities.md`; components, `dist/docs/components.pick.md`; how a deck flows
through the engine, `engineering/architecture.md`.

## Plugins — `lib/plugins/<name>/`

Each plugin adds a syntax or a fence that works on any slide. Purpose from its manifest.

| Path | Layer | Files | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lib/plugins/anima/` | 4 | 4 | Carry an Anima scene spec (JSON) from an ```anima fence to the scene slide, which the docs site's Anima host animates on the HTML and present surfaces. |
| `lib/plugins/avatars/` | 4 | 9 | Drawn stand-in portraits, written in inline code. |
| `lib/plugins/callout/` | 4 | 4 | A note pinned to one mark on a chart. |
| `lib/plugins/chart-family/` | 4 | 238 | Draws a chart slide (`_class: bar`, `line`, `gantt`, … every member of the chart bucket) from its authored list or table. |
| `lib/plugins/checks/` | 4 | 8 | The six answers a criterion can have, drawn as a disc: yes `[x]`, partly `[-]`, no `[!]`, unknown `[?]`, open `[ ]` and does not apply `[/]`. |
| `lib/plugins/code/` | 4 | 16 | Syntax-highlighted code for every fenced block that no other plugin claims, on any slide. |
| `lib/plugins/function-plot/` | 4 | 9 | Plot y = f(x), parametric and polar curves from a JSON config fence, drawn in the browser by function-plot. |
| `lib/plugins/icons/` | 4 | 9 | Drawn, single-color icons from a curated set of about 250 (Tabler, MIT, plus two of our own), written in inline code. |
| `lib/plugins/image/` | 4 | 10 | A picture written as a record on a line of its own. |
| `lib/plugins/legend/` | 4 | 4 | The key: what each color, swatch or line on a figure means. |
| `lib/plugins/math/` | 4 | 31 | Typeset TeX on any slide: $…$ inline, and $$…$$ or a ```math fence for display, drawn by KaTeX at parse time. |
| `lib/plugins/mermaid/` | 4 | 140 | Flowcharts, sequence, state, class, Gantt and the rest of Mermaid's diagram types from a fence. |
| `lib/plugins/meta/` | 4 | 4 | How a deck is read. Owns the slide-metadata fields an author sets in an HTML comment (`<!-- _class: cards -->`, `<!-- _footer: Q3 review -->`) and nothing else. |
| `lib/plugins/pills/` | 4 | 7 | Shaped, colored labels written in inline code. |
| `lib/plugins/sparks/` | 4 | 6 | Word-sized charts written in inline code. |
| `lib/plugins/video/` | 4 | 12 | A video as a static, PDF-safe poster that links to the clip, on any slide, written in inline code on a line of its own. |
